page_title: RAY 3-1 OSA | Rayo Vallecano v Osasuna 16/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Alejandro Quintero is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+5' 3 - 1 The defending players give Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) far too much free space and he knows how to take advantage of it. He produces a howitzer in the direction of the right side of the target. Sergio Herrera was taken unawares by his effort and the score is 3:1.
90+3' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Quintero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
90+1' Rayo Vallecano failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag and Rayo Vallecano will take a corner.
88' Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
88' The game is interrupted. Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and James Rodriguez (Rayo Vallecano) is coming onto the pitch as Alvaro Garcia cannot continue after picking up an injury.
87' Here comes a substitution. Sergio Guardiola (Rayo Vallecano) is brought on as a substitute for Sergio Camello.
84' Vicente Moreno has decided to make a change. Moi Gomez (Osasuna) replaces Bryan Zaragoza.
83' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) gets free in the box and latches onto a good cross, but somehow he sends the ball narrowly wide of the right post from the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat.
82' Osasuna fail to score from a corner as Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) leaps to collect the ball.

81' Osasuna move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Osasuna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
79' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
78' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
77' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
76' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) goes off the pitch and Jose Manuel Arnaiz comes on.
76' The manager makes a subsitution with Ruben Pena (Osasuna) coming on for Jon Moncayola.
73' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
73' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
73' The ball goes out for a corner. Rayo Vallecano can continue in their attacking effort.
72' Rayo Vallecano showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
71' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish!
70' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 65:35.
66' 2 - 1 Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) breaks through the defence and scores a brilliant goal from outside the penalty area after firing the ball inside the right post!
66' Substitution. Raul Garcia will be replaced by Ante Budimir (Osasuna).
66' Vicente Moreno has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) replacing Aimar Oroz.
65' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
64' It will be a substitution. Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is ready to enter the pitch as Gerard Gumbau walks off.
62' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
59' Alejandro Quintero shows the yellow card to Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) for a heavy challenge.
59' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
57' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
57' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
57' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Oscar Trejo will be replaced by Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano).
57' The referee signals a substitution. Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is brought on as a substitute for Adrian Embarba.

55' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) latches on to the corner kick and releases a quick strike from the edge of the box. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way over the crossbar.
55' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
55' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Alejandro Catena (Osasuna), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
55' Osasuna get a corner.
55' Osasuna are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence.
53' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

53' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to release Adrian Embarba with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. Rayo Vallecano are awarded a corner kick.
50' 1 - 1 Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) produces a moment of pure magic and scores a spectacular goal by striking the ball into the top left corner of the net!
50' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
50' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked. Good work from Rayo Vallecano as they win a corner.
49' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
47' The attendance is 13073.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.

45' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Sergio Herrera pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
45' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Oscar Trejo, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
44' It's a nice effort by Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Sergio Herrera. Easy save.
42' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
41' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
41' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
40' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
39' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
38' A corner kick by Osasuna is thwarted by the well prepared Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano).
38' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Osasuna have a corner.
36' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
31' The possession of the ball – 61:39.
29' The resulting set piece from Rayo Vallecano is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
29' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Rayo Vallecano earn a corner.

27' 0 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Raul Garcia (Osasuna) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the right post. Augusto Batalla just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 0:1.
26' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
25' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though.
23' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
20' Referee Alejandro Quintero halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Vicente Moreno, then shows him a yellow.
19' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) protests to the referee and receives a yellow card.
17' Rayo Vallecano work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

16' The game is pretty dull as Rayo Vallecano are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball. The linesman makes the right call and Rayo Vallecano will have a corner.

14' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) was in a good position when he received the ball from the free kick and produced a shot from the edge of the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, he only hit his teammate.
12' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Rayo Vallecano.
12' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rayo Vallecano comes to nothing.

11' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) with a wonderful solo effort. He blasted from long range, but the shot towards the bottom left corner was thwarted by Sergio Herrera. Now Rayo Vallecano have a corner.
10' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
9' A crossfield pass from Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
5' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
4' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) strikes from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save.
2' The free kick from long range, taken by Rayo Vallecano, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

The players are on the pitch and Rayo Vallecano will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Alejandro Quintero.
